title: Nuclear Plant
brief: Proper follow-up to Hangar: central plant landmark, bright-to-dark contrast, red-key detour with return, nukage hazard walkway, maze optional, chainsaw secret tease through a window, then a drop-in arena and tight exit fight. Revisiting space makes the plant feel like a place.
landmarks: nukage walkway with matched ceiling ribs
chainsaw on pedestal seen through window
pacing_notes: Teach plant reading early; maze is optional pressure; walkway is hero space; drop arena is peak; exit is tight coda.

part_designs.shape: medium tech corridor into a larger first room
part_designs.elevation: flat; tall enough to feel industrial
part_designs.cover: central construction / pillars create soft flanks
part_designs.detail: First room already has a mid-structure so the player strafes around cover, not a empty box.

part_designs.shape: large room with a built object / passageway through the middle
part_designs.elevation: core may sit higher; side floors lower
part_designs.cover: the core itself is the landmark and cover
part_designs.mobs: packed on UV near north edge—south edge softer
part_designs.triggers: west lift to shotgun; routes branching out
part_designs.detail: Hub you recognize later; geometry teaches 'go around' and 'go up'.

part_designs.shape: narrow lift alcove off the core
part_designs.mobs: imp (and more on high skills) hard to see with status bar
part_designs.detail: Weapon reward paired with a vertical surprise—classic Romero teach/test.

part_designs.shape: side rooms leading to red card, then return to red door
part_designs.detail: Key is off the straight line; player must reread the hub to progress.

part_designs.shape: room with switch island in acid
part_designs.triggers: switch opens maze door across the hall
part_designs.detail: Hazard + switch = agency; also opens optional maze (choice).

part_designs.mobs: many former-humans on UV; audio hunting
part_designs.detail: Optional ammo/secret pressure cooker; automap and sound matter; not required for exit.

part_designs.shape: pedestal room seen through window before reachable
part_designs.elevation: chainsaw on raised pillar in acid that later drains
part_designs.triggers: switch elsewhere drains acid / lowers pillar
part_designs.detail: See-it-before-you-get-it desire line; window is the affordance.

part_designs.shape: long grated / walkway over acid; orthogonal outer shell
part_designs.elevation: walkway above hazard; ceiling ribs echo the path
part_designs.mobs: imps as turret threats along the run
part_designs.textures: nukage flats; poison signage; tech borders
part_designs.detail: Hero room: height contrast, hazard literacy, memorable silhouette.

part_designs.shape: sunken fight pit with upper ledges
part_designs.elevation: elevator drop into pit; ledges hold turret imps
part_designs.cover: pit pillars / corners; upper pickups after
part_designs.triggers: lever at back opens flanking exits
part_designs.detail: Peak fight after breadcrumb medkits warn you; vertical threat layers.

part_designs.shape: two lit doorways after lever—converge downstairs
part_designs.light: bright door mouths vs dark pit
part_designs.detail: False choice that still feels generous; lighting sells the portals.

part_designs.shape: tight room, exit switch centered, windows out
part_designs.mobs: zombie pack + imp; possible jump-scare at switch
part_designs.detail: Coda fight in a smaller volume; outdoor windows keep Phobos place-identity.

design_lessons: Optional maze vs mandatory hero walkway
Warn with supplies before a drop fight
Exit is tighter than the peak arena
Light hierarchy: bright start, dark maze, lit portals
